msg: Red and purple gnomes are linked in terms of reward, and green and brown gnome are also linked. Focus on the colour of gnomes: if you click red or purple and the reward is high, continue to click red or purple to get the higher reward (over 3points); if you click green or brown and the reward is high, continue to click the gnomes of those colours. However, the higher reward sometimes switches during the game, so if the red or purple gnomes suddenly are giving you lower rewards (below 3points), then start clicking the green or brown gnomes instead.
